title: Introducing Spyglass: Your New Power Tool
summary: The highly anticipated Spyglass tool has officially launched, delivering powerful new functionalities to elevate your workflow.

title: Enhanced File Control
summary: Take command of your content with our improved file management system, offering dedicated controls for uploads, downloads, and how your embedded files appear in the editor.

title: Our New Public Roadmap is Here!
summary: Explore our new public roadmap page to effortlessly track our progress, discover upcoming features, and get a sneak peek at what's planned for the future.

title: Seamless Checkbox Experience
summary: Our enhanced checkboxes now offer effortless clicking and dragging, featuring a sleek, updated design for a truly seamless experience.

title: Effortless Teamwork in the Editor
summary: Experience a new level of teamwork with our enhanced editor, making real-time collaboration smoother and more intuitive than ever before.

title: Enhanced Collaboration and Shared Discoverability
summary: We've made it effortless to discover and collaborate on shared ideas and quests, ensuring you always find the valuable content you and your collaborators need to succeed.

title: Global Language Support
summary: Experience Noeko in more languages as we introduce extensive international language support.

title: Noeko is Now Open Source
summary: Noeko's codebase is now fully open source, empowering our community with maximum control, direct involvement in its evolution, and complete transparency.

title: Advanced Knowledge Map Insights
summary: Empower your exploration with an enhanced knowledge map that features robust filtering by tags, time, and shared items, making it easier to navigate and unlock valuable insights.

title: Precision Search and Personalized Knowledge Collections
summary: Unlock the full potential of your knowledge base by precisely filtering, sorting, and saving your searches into custom collections for easy access and deeper insights.

title: Dynamic Content Previews
summary: We're introducing flexible new ways to display and interact with your linked content, helping you organize your ideas more intuitively and dynamically.

title: Noeko: Your Way – Self-Hosted & Premium Features
summary: We're empowering you with greater flexibility to deploy Noeko on your own infrastructure or choose from new premium cloud plans that unlock advanced features tailored to your team's needs.

title: Elevate Your Aesthetic: Introducing New & Enhanced Themes
summary: Transform your experience with a vibrant collection of professionally polished existing themes and an exciting array of brand-new visual styles.

title: Smarter, More Accurate Greetings
summary: We're enhancing our homepage greetings to always perfectly match the time of day, providing a more personalized and seamless experience.

title: Efficient Tag List Management
summary: Gain valuable time back by effortlessly managing your tagged content with new actions that allow you to quickly remove items or perform other essential tasks directly from any tag view.

title: Expand Your Knowledge with Diverse Sources
summary: Seamlessly integrate a wider array of content, including YouTube videos, websites, and text files, to effortlessly consolidate all your essential information in one place.
